summary: Verified Jan-2026 passport features end-to-end via Playwright on preview URL. (1) 'Use passport name' flow: generated passport PNG uploaded to a throwaway athlete 'TEST Anita Sharma' → real Gemini OCR returned name 'ANITA DEVI SHARMA' → id-self-passport-name-warning rendered with exact spec text 'Name is NOT exactly the same — passport: "ANITA DEVI SHARMA" · database: "TEST Anita Sharma"'. Clicking id-self-passport-use-name hid the warning, mf-name field updated in place to 'Anita Devi Sharma' (Title Case per backend normalisation). Confirmed number+expiry then saved form → 'Member updated' toast; GET /api/members returns full_name='Anita Devi Sharma' (NOT reverted). Members row in the list immediately re-renders as 'Anita Devi Sharma'. (2) Weekly WhatsApp popup: seeded a throwaway athlete with passport_expiry=2000-01-01 + deleted this week's passport_reminder_log row. On admin login, passport-week-prompt rendered bottom-right with passport-week-list containing 'TEST Expired Passport — 2000-01-01'. passport-week-later hid it, and after SPA nav to /admin/members it stayed hidden (sessionStorage key passport-week-later=<ISO Monday>). After clearing sessionStorage + reload the popup returned (same week, nothing posted yet). passport-week-send stub-captured window.open target was https://web.whatsapp.com/send?text=🛂%20*Passports%20expired%20%2F%20expiring%20within%206%20months*… — popup closed. A SECOND fresh browser context, same admin, did NOT see the popup (backend passport_reminder_log row suppresses it for the week). (3) Travel check: inserted test regatta {id:test-reg-qa, country:Portugal, end_date:2099-07-10}; /admin/id-documents → id-docs-tab-travel rendered travel-check with travel-regatta showing only 'TEST Worlds · Portugal · 2099-07-01', travel-needed='Passport must be valid until 2100-01-10'. travel-row-<exp_mid> present with travel-issue-<id>='Not valid 6 months after the regatta'. Table lists ONLY non-OK rows by default; travel-show-ok checkbox present. (4) Cleanup: deleted both throwaway members (200), test regatta, and this week's passport_reminder_log row.

issues: AbsentDispatchPrompt (full-screen bg-black/40 overlay) blocks every click on the page below until dismissed. Combined with the passport-week-prompt (bottom-right) and the leave-report prompt, three admin modals compete for attention on fresh login. Playwright had to click absent-dispatch-dismiss before any admin action was possible; a human admin faces the same friction. Consider deferring the overlay prompts to a top-right toast stack so they don't block interaction.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/id_docs.py use_passport_name() correctly title-cases every word (w[:1].upper()+w[1:].lower()) so 'ANITA DEVI SHARMA' → 'Anita Devi Sharma' — matches the problem spec. field is 'full_name' for self and '<person>_name' for parents. Returns {field,name} so the FE can patch the right form field — IdDocsSection passes it to onNameChanged which MemberForm wires to set(field,v). Verified live for self; parent path (father) is symmetric and uses the same endpoint — not re-tested due to OCR cost but code path is identical.

frontend/PassportExpiryPrompt.jsx HIDE_KEY uses sessionStorage with the ISO Monday as its value, so the hide is tied to both the browser tab AND the specific week — exactly the intended semantics. send() closes the popup optimistically then POSTs; if two admins click Send simultaneously the backend $setOnInsert makes the second a no-op and the FE shows a 'Already posted this week by …' info toast — safe.

backend/routes/id_docs.py travel_check() filters regattas by {end_date>=today, country NOT IN [None,'','India','india','IN']} — case-insensitive India exclusion is weak (e.g. 'INDIA' or 'india ' would slip through). Consider normalising on write or using a regex. Not a functional bug for the current data.

backend/routes/id_docs.py _expiry_status() and travel_check() both clamp day to min(d,28) when adding 6 months to avoid Feb overflow — same minor edge case flagged in iter99. Fine for the current use (6-month warning threshold), but worth a code comment.

frontend/BulkIdUpload.jsx use-name onUseName calls the same /passport/use-name endpoint and patches only the local row's nameMatches — it does NOT refresh the member list the bulk tab holds in state, so the next passport scanned for the same member will still see the OLD db name until the slots prop is refetched. Minor; the user flow does one pass. Keep in mind if we add per-row re-match.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 scenarios: use-name warning renders, use-name click updates mf-name + hides warning + persists after save, weekly popup renders+lists, Later hides for session, Send opens WhatsApp URL + closes + marks posted, 2nd admin suppressed, Travel tab regatta select + valid_until + issue label)

test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 (Admin sign in with email toggle)
seed_data_creation: Created 2 throwaway athletes (TEST Anita Sharma, TEST Expired Passport) + 1 test regatta (test-reg-qa, Portugal) + wiped this week's passport_reminder_log row. All removed at teardown. Seed script preserved at /app/test_reports/iter100_seed.py; generated passport PNG at /tmp/passport_iter100.png (not committed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'absent-dispatch-dismiss' modal always intercepts pointer events after admin login and MUST be clicked before any further page interaction (or use force=True on every click). The passport-week-prompt sits in a bottom-right card (z-60); it does NOT block the page. For OCR flows: use a single file-input (id-self-passport-file-input) and wait up to 70s for the warning testid — a real Gemini call averages 15-25s. The member edit modal is NOT a route (/admin/members/<id>/edit redirects to /); open it via [data-testid=edit-member-<id>] on /admin/members. Backend login response uses access_token (not token) and /api/members returns a plain list in this build. BulkIdUpload use-name flow was NOT re-tested live (same code path as self); the row-level testid is bulk-row-<key>-use-name and renders only when a member is matched and card==='passport' and nameMatches===false — all present in the component.
flows_verified: POST /api/members/<id>/id-docs/self/passport (via UI file input) → OCR detects name/number/expiry; mismatch triggers name-warning with Use-passport-name button
POST /api/members/<id>/id-docs/self/passport/use-name → PUT users.full_name to Title Case; FE patches mf-name live; subsequent save does NOT revert; GET /api/members confirms persistence
GET /api/id-docs/passport-expiry-week returns due:true + rows when a member has expired passport_expiry and the week has no log row; shaped as week/rows/sent
FE passport-week-prompt renders only when due && sessionStorage.passport-week-later != week
passport-week-later writes sessionStorage[passport-week-later]=week; stays hidden across SPA navigation in same tab
passport-week-send opens whatsapp URL with the full list text + POSTs passport-expiry-week → suppresses popup in ALL subsequent admin sessions this week

GET /api/id-docs/travel-check with no overseas regatta would return travel-none message; with one, returns regatta/regattas/rows/valid_until_needed; rows carry issue in {missing,no_expiry,expiring,null}
FE TravelCheck hides OK rows unless travel-show-ok is ticked; renders travel-row-<id> and travel-issue-<id> for each row with an issue
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. One observational note: when a fresh admin logs in, three modals (AbsentDispatchPrompt full-screen overlay, LeaveReportPrompt, PassportExpiryPrompt bottom-right card) all pop at once. Only PassportExpiryPrompt is non-blocking; the other two make the UI feel cluttered on Monday mornings and partially occlude the Members table. Consider sequencing them or stacking as right-side toasts.
